events.title: Mike Ashley’s Frasers acquires nearly 6% stake in Puma
events.body: The deal would also make Frasers Puma’s second-largest shareholder behind the Pinault family.

events.title: Frasers Group agrees to acquire majority stake in Italy’s Maxi Sport
events.body: Maxi Sport was established in 1989 with its first location in Merate. The company’s retail presence extends to an online platform, which has been operating since 2002.
